usedBy: Use this building block at the bottom of a mobile payment screen. The screen owns sticky positioning and safe-area insets.
overview: A mobile payment footer with an optional main row, optional details, a required total, an optional notice and a full-width action.

default.title: Default
default.text: The default body has a white surface and a 1px top border. The root itself has no background.

highlight.title: Highlight
highlight.text: The highlight body uses the light-up surface and 12px top corners.

with-notice.title: With notice
with-notice.text: The notice can contain only a description. Its body covers 16px of the notice.

with-notice-highlight.title: Highlight with notice
with-notice-highlight.text: The highlight body overlaps the notice by 16px and sits above it.

notice-title-icon.title: Notice with title and icon
notice-title-icon.text: Title and icon are optional. The icon defaults to the Ocean positive check icon; pass null to hide it.

main-item-only.title: Main item only
main-item-only.text: The main item is independent from details and uses default density.

details-only.title: Details only
details-only.text: Details can be shown without a main item. Details use compact density.

four-details.title: Four details
four-details.text: Use no more than four details as a screen-level usage rule. The component renders every supplied detail.

api.intro: The React component receives label/value rows in separate mainItem and details roles. It renders all supplied details and leaves business behavior to the consumer.
api.type: Body appearance. `default` is white with a top border; `highlight` uses the light-up surface and rounded top corners.
api.mainItem: Optional label/value row with default density. It is never inferred from the first detail.
api.details: Optional label/value rows with compact density. Use at most four as a screen-level rule; the component does not truncate the list.
api.total: Required label/value row with bold 16px typography. A divider precedes it whenever a main item or details are present.
api.notice: Optional structured notice. Description is required; title is optional. An omitted icon uses the Ocean positive check icon, while `icon={null}` hides it.
api.action: Required consumer-provided action, rendered full width inside the body.
api.className: Additional class name for the component root.

platforms.text: The Footer is also available in SwiftUI and Jetpack Compose. iOS keeps `.legacy` as the default; use `.v2(...)` for this API. Android keeps the deprecated overload and adds the overload with total, button, type, notice, mainItem and details.

rules: Use Footer at the bottom of a mobile payment screen; the screen owns sticky positioning and safe-area insets.
A row contains only a label and a value. Use mainItem and details independently; the component never promotes the first detail to main.
Use no more than four details as a screen-level usage rule. Footer renders every item it receives.
Main and total use default density; details use compact density. Dividers appear after a main item when details follow and before total whenever rows are above it.
The notice is a separate piece above the body; the body covers 16px of it.
Use the 2.0 API on web. Transaction Footer 1.0 remains deprecated on iOS and Android.
